field.label: Enable Caddy
field.help: Enable or disable the Caddy web server.

field.label: Run user
field.help: User the caddy process runs as. The redistributed caddy package recommends www:www for unprivileged operation (needs privileged port binding for 80/443, e.g. security/portacl-rc).

field.label: Run group
field.help: Group the caddy process runs as.

field.label: Log level
field.help: Minimum log level for the caddy process. Delivered to the process as the CADDY_LOG_LEVEL env var (via the envfile); the seeded Caddyfile references it in its global log block. Once the Caddyfile is user-owned, the referenced value wins.

field.label: Environment file
field.help: Secrets and tuning env vars delivered to the caddy process via --envfile. Managed as a masked grid on the editor page.
